svg.title: One map unit from fifty meioses
svg.desc: A B and a b homologs. Forty-nine meioses without crossover produce 196 parental chromatids. One meiosis with a single reciprocal nonsister exchange produces AB Ab aB ab: two parental and two recombinant chromatids. Two recombinant products among 200 is 1%; one crossover meiosis among fifty is 2%.
